modules.module_title: Prepare the service and dining area

pcs.pc_description: set the table with linens, tableware and glasses and cutlery.
arrange essentials such as paper napkins, ketchup, pickle, salt and pepper, etc. properly on the table
set up and check the side station with essential equipment’s for smooth service

modules.module_title: Prepare the conference and meeting area as per organizational policy

pcs.pc_description: set up trolley with essential equipment
arrange tea/ coffee and snakes for tea breaks
ensure the availability of conference pad and pens etc. if required

modules.module_title: Provide in room dining services as per organizational policy

pcs.pc_description: set up IRD trolley with IRD tray, cutlery, etc. as per the order under supervision.
ensure delivery of food and beverage as per the requirement of the guest

modules.module_title: Perform cleaning activities as per organizational policy

pcs.pc_description: ensure the cleanliness of the food service area such as dining tables, sideboards, trolleys, counters, etc. as per the organizational standards.
ensure that service equipment (glasses, platters, bowls, etc.) is clean, functional, free of damage and located where it should be.
check if there is sufficient stock of service ready clean and damage free items such as salver, service spoons, bread basket, tongs
ensure that dining furniture, table linen and table items are undamaged and properly polished.
check the menus and promotional items for cleanliness.
ensure the cleanliness of IRD tray, trolly, and side station.

modules.module_title: Perform clearance activities as per organisational policies

pcs.pc_description: clean and rearrange the tables when the guest has left.
ensure plates are removed without disturbing guests when they finish an item.
send plate, cutlery, crockery and glassware for cleaning.
dispose-off broken, cracked items and other waste if required.

pcs.pc_description: layout buffet table as per instructions.
wipe crockery, cutlery and glass as per Standard Operating Procedure (SOP).
ensure cleanliness at the buffet counter.
refill the water in the buffet chafing dish and ice cream on ice counter.
place the salad stand on the salad counter.
place accessories at buffet counter as per Standard Operating Procedure (SOP).
pick up the dishes from the kitchen on the instruction of a supervisor.
switch the induction on/off as per the instruction from supervisor.
place buffet signs 10 minutes before the out time.
place dishes in their respective areas and open all the food pan cover/lid.
remove all name tags from the buffet counter.
remove dishes from the counter.
place all the food pans, wiping sheets, bread and butter plates in the washing area.
clean buffet counter as per Standard Operating Procedure (SOP).
